div.head: VIII Atr 25
div.ab: And ne þearf ænig mynstermunuc ahwar mid rihte fæhðbote biddan ne fæhðbote betan; he gæð of his mæglage þonne he gebihð to regollage.
And ne þearf ænig mynstermunuc ahwar mid rihte fæhðbote biddan ne fæhðbote betan; he gæð of his mæglage, þonne he gebihð to regollage.
And no monk who belongs to a monastery anywhere may lawfully either demand or pay any compensation incurred by vendetta. He leaves the law of his kindred behind when he accepts monastic rule.
And no monk anywhere who belongs to a monastery is permitted to either claim or pay compensation related to a feud; he renounces the rights of his kindred when he accepts the monastic rule.
And no cloistered monk anywhere need by rights demand compensation in a feud nor pay compensation in a feud; he leaves the obligations of kinship when he submits to the monastic rule.

Und nicht darf ein Klostermönch irgendwo gesetzlich Geldbusse für Todtschlag [verübt an seinem Verwandten] fordern noch auch Geldbusse für Todtschlag [verübt durch seinen Verwandten] zahlen: er tritt aus seinem Sippenrecht, sobald er sich dem Rechte der Ordensregel unterwirft.

And no monk of a minster may anywhere lawfully demand feud-compensation [for the killing of his kinsman] or pay feud-compensation [for a killing by his kinsman]: he leaves his kin-law when he submits to the law of the rule.
